# CO3 Premium Liquid Shop

CO3 Premium Liquid Shop is a premium bubble-tea, coffee, ice-cream, soda, mocktail and dessert-drink brand in Rawalpindi, Pakistan.

Canonical site: https://co3premiumliquids.com/
Primary location: Bahria Town, Phase 4, Rawalpindi, Punjab, Pakistan
Phone / WhatsApp: +92 303 6303111
Ordering: Customers can order through WhatsApp from product cards and offer cards.
Currency: PKR
Price range: Rs 140 – Rs 800, exclusive of tax
Hours: Daily from 12:00 PM until late

## Brand positioning

CO3 serves playful-premium drinks with a luxury café feel: boba milk tea, ceremonial matcha, single-origin espresso drinks, slow-churned ice cream, fresh shakes, bubble soda, iced tea, coladas, mojitos, margaritas, smoothies, lassi and zero-sugar refreshers.

Core taglines:
- Refresh Your Mood, Fuel Your Day
- Scoop into Happiness
- Good Vibes. Great Drinks.
- tiny bubbles, big mood
- Chill more. Overthink less. Sip CO3.

## Menu categories

- Boba and bubble tea
- Matcha
- Hot and iced coffee
- Ice cream and ice cream shakes
- Fresh shakes and smoothies
- Bubble soda, CO3 soda and slush

- Lassi and zero-sugar refreshers

For the latest menu, products, settings and offers, the public site can read runtime data from `/admin/api.php` with static fallback data built into the Next.js export.
